name: Betelgeuse
tagline: El hombro rojo de Orión: una supergigante que vive de tiempo prestado.
history: Betelgeuse es una supergigante roja tan grande que colocada en la posición del Sol engulliría el cinturón de asteroides. Barely ten million years old, it has already burned through its hydrogen and swollen toward death — it will collapse and explode as a supernova sometime within the next hundred thousand years, shining for weeks as bright as the Moon. Between late 2019 and early 2020 it dimmed to a third of its brightness in the 'Great Dimming', later traced by Hubble to a colossal surface eruption ejecting a dust cloud. El evento demostró que las supergigantes rojas pueden perder masa violentamente, remodelando los modelos de supernova.
